questions.question: When people brought little children to Jesus for Him to bless, what did His disciples do?

answers.text: Rebuked the people who brought them
Lined the children up for Him
Carried the children to Jesus themselves

questions.question: When a man ran up and knelt before Jesus calling Him Good Teacher, what did he ask?

answers.text: What he must do to inherit eternal life
Which commandment is the most important
Where Jesus would be teaching next

questions.question: Jesus said it is hard for a rich man to enter God's kingdom. What did He say is easier?

answers.text: A camel passing through the eye of a needle
A boulder floating across the Jordan River
A tower built all the way up to the sky
